title: CIP: Support object-specific services
description:
1. Support a 2 tuple key (Class, Service) lookup for object-specific service behavior/dissecting.
2. Support service lookup from the ENIP dissector (this is another CIP dissector)
3. Add Service: Identity -> Reset
4. Add Service: Certificate Management -> Verify Certificate
5. Remove Reset as a common service format. The format is always object-specific

Sample pcap: [cip_object_specific_services.pcapng](/uploads/75d4a9118586d5afe0035976edcba4b6/cip_object_specific_services.pcapng)
